subject: Preferred server OS for Shiny Server Pro

messages.author: 25b664c6d43fea95
messages.subject: Preferred server OS for Shiny Server Pro
parts:
Shiny server pro is supported for several OS.  Is there a preferred one that makes some aspects of the shiny server and the shiny apps more or less efficient/stable?
We typically use  an enterprise RedHat 6, but are rebuilding and would consider a change.  Thanks,
Bruce

messages.author: f562cc721b7e9a13
messages.subject: Re: Preferred server OS for Shiny Server Pro
parts:
Hi Bruce,

My understanding is a consistent feature set in Shiny Server across supported OSs. You are probably best off sticking with the platform that your team regularly supports. 

App performance is heavily tied to app traits (CPU heavy- simulation/bootstrapping, memory heavy - data mining, IO heavy - data warehouse like activities, etc) and your hardware choices/deployment architecture.
